name: @ariadnev-web/site
description: Astro marketing site. Implementation arrives in Phase 6; this manifest pins its dependency and script surface now so parallel phases never edit the shared lockfile.

scripts.build: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('astro.config.mjs')){console.log('@ariadnev-web/site: no app source yet (Phase 6 owns it); skipping build');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('astro build',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.check: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('astro.config.mjs')){console.log('@ariadnev-web/site: no app source yet (Phase 6 owns it); skipping build');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('astro build',{stdio:'inherit'})"
